attacks.name: Adamantium Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Berserker Barrage
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
After the attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: The Best At What I Do . . .
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. When making this attack, each |!wild| in the attack roll counts as 2 successes. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Adamantium Skeleton
superPowers.body: When determining if this character can be Thrown or Pushed by an effect or special rule, or when it is colliding with another character or a terrain feature, this character counts as |!size| 3.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on the Healthy side.
Stamina increased from 5 to 6 on the Injured side.
